headline: Saudi Labor Reforms Contributed to Decline in Kenyan Diaspora Remittances
summary: Changes in Saudi Arabia's labor laws contributed to a decline in the number of Kenyan workers in the country, affecting money sent home, according to the Central Bank of Kenya.
why: Remittances are a critical source of foreign exchange and household income for developing nations dependent on diaspora labor markets.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Lower remittance inflows reduce household purchasing power and foreign currency availability.
